'''Accel Animation Studios''' is an Indian animation studio that provides [[traditional animation|2D]], [[3D animation]], visual effects and gaming services to companies in India and overseas. It is a division of [[Chennai]]-based technology services company, [[Accel Transmatic Limited]] and was formed in 2006.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-business/accel-transmatic-sets-up-animation-studio/article3107656.ece | newspaper=The Hindu | title=Accel Transmatic sets up animation studio | date=20 July 2006 | access-date=4 October 2018 }}</ref>

==History==
Accel Animation Studios was founded in 2006 in [[Chennai]]. It is a part of Accel Transmatic Limited and has facilities spanning across [[Chennai]] and [[Thiruvananthapuram]]. The company has over 80 animators working in its offices in [[Thiruvananthapuram]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Accel Animation to expand operations |url= https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/accel-animation-to-expand-operations/article20323375.ece1#|work= Business Line|location= [[Kerala]]|access-date= 1 January 2020}}</ref>
In 2013, Accel Animation set up its subsidiary in [[Kerala]] called Mocap Studio.<ref>{{cite news |date= 5 February 2013|title=Accel Animation sets up mocap studio |url= https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/accel-animation-sets-up-mocap-studio-107110601076_1.html|work= Business Standard|access-date= 1 January 2020}}</ref>

== Locations ==

Accel Animation Studios has production facilities at two locations in [[India]] - [[Chennai]] and [[Thiruvananthapuram|Trivandram]]. As of 2011, both the facilities enjoy promotional duty and tax exemptions as animation industry is considered a new venture by the [[government of India]]. The infrastructure includes a Windows-based computer cluster, quad-core workstations and high-speed connectivity using Cisco Catalyst 4500 'E' series switch. It also includes a 32 Camera [[Motion Capture]] System, on site audio recording and editing suite.{{Citation needed|date=July 2022}}

Outside [[India]], the company has operations in [[California]], [[United States]].<ref>[http://www.indiainfoline.com/company/discorpnews.asp?storyId=50418&lmn=4&tbl=ocx_a Indiainfoline.com<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723115616/http://www.indiainfoline.com/company/discorpnews.asp?storyId=50418&lmn=4&tbl=ocx_a |date=23 July 2011 }}</ref>
